Much like the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8918]Original[/url] this removes the wait time for tools to be upgraded. The Redux also add options for adjusting the costs.

Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47136]Wallet Tools[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47246]Tool and Sprinkler Upgrades[/url].

Just as with the Original mod 100% of Donation Points earned by this mod go to the [url=http://www.wcs.org/]Wildlife Conservation Society[/url]﻿.

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
